name: qa-guide
description: Shows Claude's questions in a side pane with context, option details, an AI explanation and answer history; also explains questions Claude asks in plain text.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language for pane labels and AI explanations (auto detects each question).

showCost.title: API price estimate
showCost.description: Show an API-price estimate beside measured tokens (subscriptions use usage limits).

context.title: Context
context.description: Context for AI explanations (compact uses Haiku; full uses the whole session).

chatQuestions.title: Plain-text questions
chatQuestions.description: Detect when Claude ends a turn with a question in plain text and offer an AI explanation above the prompt.
